messages:
Zoe CSM: Quick: assembling a one-line "cheatcode" and tiny ops play AEs can paste into kickoff notes. Must cover prefill, batching, streaming fallback, and renewal triggers. Keep it ultra-short.
Arun SE: Keep two lanes: customer-facing sentence + ops knobs. Exact numbers for TTL, batch sizes, alert thresholds.
Mei DevEx: I'll add two copy/paste snippets: prefill curl + tiny PromQL.
Zoe CSM: Customer paste (1 line): 'We'll prefill your top-5 intents to reduce cold tails; expect ~10 min warm window and p95 < 800ms for ramp flows.'
Arun SE: Ops knobs (copy): prefill_ttl=900s (use 1800s if stateful), warm_pool=true for enterprise, burst_pool_ttl=300s, batch_target_tokens=1024.
Mei DevEx: Prefill curl (copy):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-1","intents":["intent1","intent2","intent3","intent4","intent5"],"ttl":900}'
```
Mei DevEx: PromQL smoke (copy):
```promql
100 * sum(rate(redwood_cache_hit_total[5m])) / sum(rate(redwood_request_total[5m]))
```
Arun SE: Client pattern: jitter 0-150ms + 2 fast retries. If stream_err_rate > 8% in 10m, fallback to non-streaming and notify SE.
Victor PM: Renewal triggers (copy): sustained p95 > 1s for 24h, cache hit < 40% for 48h, stream errors > 8% for 3 days, WoW cost spike > 20%.
Zoe CSM: Recovery play (copy): 1) expand warm pool & prefill additional intents, 2) lower batch_target_tokens to 512 during spike, 3) offer routing to quantized model behind QA gate.
TriageBot: Confluence link created: https://confluence.redwood.ai/onboarding/cheatcode-onboard-play
Zoe CSM: Nice. I'll paste this into the kickoff doc and send to the AE. Thanks all :clap:
